title: San Diego Haunted Scavenger Hunt Adventure
includes: One scavenger hunt interactive walking tour for your entire group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must have smartphone with cellular data service.
IMPORTANT: Registration Instructions will be found on the Voucher & Email after completing purchase
Must be able to walk around 2 miles.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Unravel the spooky secrets of Old Town San Diego with this interactive scavenger hunt that blends thrilling exploration with historical lore. Navigate through haunted sites like the Cosmopolitan Hotel, where spectral stories linger, and the Whaley House, echoing with the tales of 'Yankee Jim'. As you piece together clues, uncover the chilling past of Pioneer Park, where the living tread lightly over the resting places of the departed. Perfect for families, friends, or couples looking for a unique outing, this adventure allows you to explore at your own pace while enjoying a day filled with eerie excitement.
